data.title: A2 · 清晨的热饮
data.description: 晨光穿过避难所破损的百叶窗。A2 穿着宽松衬衫坐在床边，低头吹凉手里的热饮。
data.promptProse: Sitting on the edge of a makeshift cot in a bombed-out resistance sanctuary, A2 blows gently across a battered tin mug of steaming hot ration tea, waiting for it to cool. Harsh morning daylight cuts through cracked, hanging metal blinds, casting stark industrial slashes of shadow across the concrete bunker floor and her scarred, battle-worn chassis.
data.animaCaption: She waits for the drink to cool.
